name: vertical-thumbnail-autostart-slider
blurb: Vertical carousel with auto-play and thumbnail column navigation.
description: Vertical carousel with embla-carousel autoplay plugin (2-second interval). Displays main slide vertically with thumbnails strip. Auto-advances every 2 seconds and continues on interaction.
use_when: Product or portfolio galleries that should cycle automatically with user-clickable thumbnails.
avoid_when: Accessibility contexts—auto-play without pause button violates WCAG guidelines.
a11y: Thumbnails are clickable slide selectors. No keyboard controls or pause button. Autoplay cannot be stopped. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
